topic: Rebuild a sales team with Claude Code (allbound workflow)

claims.claim: Workflow structure adapted from Understory x OXYGEN's 'The allbound engine' graphic (shared by Alok): Claude Code runs every step through MCP and CLI; source, enrich+qualify, decision makers, email verify, ad audiences, multichannel outbound, founder LinkedIn posts, capture signals, follow-up referencing what they saw, retarget, log in CRM; human approves each send and paid run.
Claude Code connects to external tools through MCP servers added with `claude mcp add`.

sources.title: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP

claims.claim: Ad platforms accept uploaded contact/company lists as audiences: LinkedIn Matched Audiences, Google Ads Customer Match, Meta Custom Audiences.
Company and people names, counts (2,400) and scores are illustrative examples and labelled EXAMPLE where numeric.
